तड् {c10c} U. (ताडयति-ते, ताडित)
1
To beat, strike (in general), dash
against; गाहंतां महिषा निपानसलिलं
शृंगैर्मुहस्ताडितं Ś. 2. 5; (नौः) ताडिता
मारुतैर्यथा Rām.;

.
--2 To beat, strike,
punish by beating, hit; लालयेत्पंच
वर्षाणि दश वर्षाणि ताडयेत्

.
--3 To
strike, beat (as a drum);
ताड्यमानासुभेरीषु Mb.; अताडयन् मृदंगांश्च

.
--4 To play on,
strike the wires of (a musical
instrument); श्रोतुर्वितंत्रीरिव ताड्यमाना

.
--5 To shine.
--6 To
speak.
--7 (In astr.) To strike
against, touch, obscure or eclipse
partially.
--8 (In Math.) To multiply.

तडि a. Beating.
--डिः Striking, a
stroke.

ताडिः --डी f.
1 A kind of palm.
--2 A kind of ornament.

ताड a. [तड् भावे अच्] Beating,
striking.
--डः
1 A blow, knock,
thumb, whipping, chastisement.
--2
Noise, sound.
--3 A sheaf.
--4 A
mountain.
--Comp.
--घ a. beating
with a whip or strokes of any kind.
--घः, --घातः an artificer who beats
or hammers, a smith.

ताडन a. [तड् भावे ल्युट्] Beating,
whipping, striking.
--नं
1 Beating,
whipping, flogging; लालने बहवो
दोषास्ताडने बहवो गुणाः

.
--2 (In astr.) Touching, partial
eclipse.
--ना Striking.
--नी A whip.

ताडित p. p. Struck, beaten,
chastised.

ताड्यमान a. Being beaten or
struck; श्रोतुर्वितंत्रीरिव ताड्यमाना

.
--नः A musical instrument struck
with a stick &c. (as a drum).

तडागः --गं
1 A pond, deep pool,
tank;
स्फुटकमलोदरखेलितखंजनयुगमिव शरदि तडागं

.
--2 A tank.
--3 A trap
for catching deer.

तडाकः A pond, pool.
--का
1 A
blow.
--2 A bank, shore.
--3
Splendour, lustre.

तडागः --गं
1 A pond, deep pool,
tank;
स्फुटकमलोदरखेलितखंजनयुगमिव शरदि तडागं

.
--2 A tank.
--3 A trap
for catching deer.

तडाघातः See तटाघात; (
उच्चैःकरिकराक्षेपे तडाघातं विदुर्बुधाः Śabdak.).

.
--2 Killing, injury. --ind.
Closely, near.
--Comp.
--गर्भः
a cloud.
--लता forked lightning.
--लेखा a streak of lightning.

तडित्वत् a. Containing or having
lightning; अवरोहति शैलाग्रं
तडित्वानिव तोयदः

ता(ट)डका
1 N. of a female
fiend, daughter of Suketu, wife
of Sunda and mother of Mārīca.
[She was changed into a fiend by the
sage Agastya whose devotions she had
disturbed. She was killed by Rāma
when she began to disturb the
sacrificial rites of Viśvāmitra. Rāma was
first unwilling to bend his bow
against a woman, but the sage
overcame his scruples, see

ताडकेयः [ताडकाया अपत्यं ढक्] An
epithet of the demon Mārīca, son
of Tāḍakā.

ताडाग a. (गी f.) Being in or
coming from tanks.

ताडिः --डी f.
1 A kind of palm.
--2 A kind of ornament.
